newsitem.title: USA: Enserch, Texas Utils merger under review.
newsitem.headline: Enserch, Texas Utils merger under review.

text.p: ENSERCH Corp and Texas Utilities Co said the U.S. Department of Justice has not yet completed its investigation of a proposed $1.7 billion merger between the two companies.
The two companies made two filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission on December 9, 1996 to seek approval of the deal, ENSERCH and Texas Utilities said in a joint statement.
The companies said they continue to believe there are no substantive impediments to concluding the deal, but they do not expect it to close by the end of the year.
Under the deal, Texas Utilities will acquire ENSERCH's distribution and pipeline companies with about $550 million of Texas Utilities common stock and $1.15 billion in debt and preferred stock.
ENSERCH will spin off its 83 percent-owned exploration and production company, Enserch Exploration Inc.
